project.name: Todlachie
project.boundarySource: Office for National Statistics postcode centroid supplied through Postcodes.io with an editorial study buffer
project.researchNotes: Catalogue-addition settlement gate. Nearby attractions, neighbouring settlements and private properties do not inflate the settlement score.

touristAppeal.label: Minor Interest
touristAppeal.summary: A dispersed rural locality rather than a visitor settlement.
touristAppeal.dogAccessSummary: No destination-scale dog visit or dedicated dog facilities are verified.

townGuide.headline: A recorded locality rather than a tourist destination
townGuide.intro: The coordinate uses the AB51 7SS postcode centroid and therefore remains deliberately conservative. Forest and neighbouring-village attractions are not borrowed.
perfectFor: Identifying the locality while planning a wider route
townGuide.visitorMood: Kept in the selector with its assessed score, but deliberately absent from the tourist-town map below 60.

townStudyArea.sourceName: Office for National Statistics postcode centroid supplied through Postcodes.io with an editorial study buffer
townStudyArea.notes: Todlachie has no separate NRS locality polygon in the reference dataset. The published editorial boundary is therefore the strict heritage study area; the 500 m ring is context only.

sources.name: Historic Environment Scotland local designation Shapefiles

sources.limitations: Includes statutory conservation-area, scheduled-monument and garden/designed-landscape polygons intersecting the NRS parish boundary. These are evidence layers, not construction dates or historic settlement footprints.
